mapper.select: SELECT activation.activation_id AS round_id, activation.gateway_id AS node_key, activation.join_node_key, activation.join_type, activation.expected_count, activation.status, activation.create_time, activation.released_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_parallel_join arrival WHERE arrival.tenant_id = activation.tenant_id AND arrival.instance_id = activation.instance_id AND arrival.activation_id = activation.activation_id) AS arrived_count FROM wf_gateway_activation activation WHERE activation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND activation.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY activation.create_time DESC, activation.activation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_gateway_activation SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'WAITING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wf_gateway_activation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 1 AND status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED', 'REJECTED', 'TERMINATED', 'INVALIDATED', 'CANCELLED'))
